page_title: SHU 0-2 LIV | Sheffield Utd v Liverpool 06/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Simon Hooper has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+7' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) gets inside the box and only has the keeper to beat, but smashes his shot just inches past the right post. He should have scored! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
90+5' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) was probably a bit loose with his words to Simon Hooper, who decides to show him a yellow.

90+4' 0 - 2 Goal! Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Darwin Nunez inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the roof of the net. 0:2.
90+3' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Simon Hooper shows a yellow card to Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd) for a tough tackle.

90' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
89' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
88' Here comes a substitution. Auston Trusty is given a rest as he is replaced by Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd).
87' PENALTY APPEAL after James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
86' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Vini Souza walks off the pitch to be replaced by Oliver Norwood (Sheffield Utd).
86' Jurgen Klopp has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) replacing Cody Gakpo.
86' The free kick into the penalty area from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is cleared.

85' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) brings his opponent down. Simon Hooper has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Sheffield Utd will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
84' The expression of the referee Simon Hooper is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) is shown a yellow card.
82' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
82' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
82' John Fleck (Sheffield Utd) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul. Liverpool are awarded a free kick.
78' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.

78' Darwin Nunez (Liverpool) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Wesley Foderingham guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
76' It looks like Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) saw red with that tackle. Simon Hooper won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
75' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. William Osula is replaced by Benie Traore (Sheffield Utd).
74' Substitution. John Fleck (Sheffield Utd) on for Andre Brooks.
74' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

73' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) tries to find Harvey Elliott, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
70' 20:80 – the latest ball possession ratio.
67' Here is a change. Luis Diaz is going off and Jurgen Klopp gives the last tactical orders to Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) is coming onto the pitch as Mohamed Salah cannot continue after picking up an injury.
66' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
64' Curtis Jones (Liverpool) is adjudged offside.
63' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
62' A yellow card for a tackle by Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool). Simon Hooper doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Curtis Jones comes onto the pitch because Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) simply cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
58' The game is interrupted now, Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' A pass from Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is intercepted by Wesley Foderingham and the move breaks down.
57' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

56' A cross following the corner kick finds its way to Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) inside the box and he manages to steer it under the bar. He is about to start celebrating a goal, but Wesley Foderingham makes a save in the nick of time and maintains the current score. Liverpool earn a corner.
56' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
55' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player. Now Liverpool have a corner.
52' Liverpool restart play with a quick free kick.
51' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) trips an opposition player and Simon Hooper signals a foul. Liverpool are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
50' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for a foul.
49' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
48' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd). Sheffield Utd will take a corner kick.
46' Simon Hooper blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+6' The resulting corner, taken by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), comes to nothing.

45+5' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Wesley Foderingham thwarts him with a nice save. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Liverpool.
45+3' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.
45+3' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Sheffield Utd have a free kick.
45+2' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45' We will have 6 min. of added time.

45' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Wesley Foderingham makes a great save.

42' Wasted effort! Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.

40' A dangerous towering header by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
40' Corner kick. Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) is ready to send the ball into the box.
40' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Liverpool.
37' 0 - 1 Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) meets a cross from a well-taken corner kick and fires home. His effort goes into the bottom left corner and hits the net.
37' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
37' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
36' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the middle of the goal, but Caoimhin Kelleher is alert and denies him.
34' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
34' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
32' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) tries to find Luis Diaz, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
30' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
29' Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
29' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner which is cleared.

28' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a chance to score from a corner.
26' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) was too forceful with his tackle and Simon Hooper interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
24' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) wins the ball near the penalty spot and unleashes a header towards the left post, but Wesley Foderingham is alert and denies him.
23' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
23' Luis Diaz (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
23' Simon Hooper blows his whistle as Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
22' Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick.

22' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) jumps inside the box to meet the resulting corner and steers his header into the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Liverpool win a corner kick.
22' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
21' An attempted cross from Joe Gomez (Liverpool) is cleared. The ball goes behind for a corner. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
19' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but Wesley Foderingham comes off his line to gather the ball.
18' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) inside the box.
17' The free kick is taken by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), but ball is cleared.
16' Poor challenge! Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is penalised for tripping and Simon Hooper blows his whistle. Liverpool earn a free kick.
15' Joe Gomez (Liverpool) tries to find Luis Diaz, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd will take a throw-in.

12' James McAtee (Sheffield Utd) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Caoimhin Kelleher inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
12' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
11' The corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is hurriedly cleared. The ball goes out of play. Liverpool are awarded a corner kick.
11' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Liverpool.

10' Luis Diaz sends a lofted pass into the box, Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) shows good awareness to connect with it but blazes his shot high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
9' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
8' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
5' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
5' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) jumps into a tackle and Simon Hooper signals a foul.
3' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Liverpool.

3' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) commits a rough challenge and Simon Hooper blows his whistle for an infringement. Sheffield Utd win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

The players are on the pitch and Liverpool will have the kick-off.
